sources.title: Additive Manufacturing Under Lunar Gravity and Microgravity
sources.read: Publisher experimental setup, geometry, microsections/CT and conclusions. Small simulant bead tests, not qualified products; no statistically established manufacturing-quality premium.

sources.title: Space-Based Fabrication of ZBLAN Optical Fibers
sources.read: Institutional abstract and metadata only. ISS microgravity production/selected characterization; commercial acceptance yield and lunar-gravity performance are unverified here.

sources.title: Using ISRU and Surface Construction to Define Long-Term Lunar Infrastructure Needs
sources.read: Full PDF retrieved; targeted pp1–7 and13–16 on architecture, scalability, processing, storage/transport and power. Production milestones are design guidance, not funded contracts or a market ceiling.

sources.title: Economics of In-Space Industry and Competitiveness of Lunar-Derived Rocket Propellant
sources.read: Author manuscript ground rules, cost equations, exogenous demand, learning and limitations. Equipment productivity and delivery costs inform the comparison; no price or demand path transferred.
